candidate.title: TopicEmbed uses open(url) without requiring open-uri, causing URL opens to be treated as local files
reports: app/models/topicembed.rb:48 — open(url).read relies on open-uri but topicembed.rb never requires it, so kernelopen can treat the url as a filename and raise errno::enoent; add require 'open-uri'

app/models/topicembed.rb:46 — open(url).read relies on open-uri, which is only required in pollfeed.rb; importremote works only when that job file has been loaded first (implicit load-order coupling).

app/models/topicembed.rb:48 — topicembed.rb uses open() on a url without requiring open-uri itself, relying on pollfeed.rb being loaded first (e.g. in the disqus thor task it may treat the url as a file path).

app/models/topicembed.rb:47 — importremote calls open(url) but topicembed.rb only requires nokogiri (open-uri is required in pollfeed.rb); no test exercises this load path so a nameerror/missing-require would ship undetected
